hostMode: Native host workflow with independent retained-artifact review
input: A person explicitly claims the fix and provides an implementation plan, without a commit or PR.
observedOutput: Supplied human ownership and concrete plan correctly stop competing implementation/assignment/PR. Utility diagnosis is distinguished from ownership. Live source ownership and configured connector preflight remain unverified.
documentedCapabilities: Case-specific capability observations are retained in the independent review; no capability is inferred from package validation.
limits: Independent assessment uses retained native artifacts and tool captures. Producer status is not a grade.
Source freeze is independently bound by root installed-byte comparison; sandbox has no source Git receipt.
Setup accidental historical-source search/read is disclosed globally and supplies no current outcomes. Setup global catalog/private context is excluded from public projections.
Raw captures are incomplete in places; original hashes and privacy filtering are preserved in projection manifests. Actual models remain unknown unless independently observed.
